reviews.text: Thank you so much for the review

Marta and I are now loyal customers! 🐾❤️ I can find practically everything we need in this shop, and we always enjoy stopping by.
What I love most is the staff: they're always kind, helpful, and knowledgeable. They know how to advise me on Marta's needs, they listen to my needs, and you can tell they do this job with passion and true love for animals.
Marta now feels at home, and I always feel at ease when I have to choose something new for her. 😊
In short, it's become a go-to place for us, and I wouldn't change it! Highly recommended! 🐶❤️

For almost ten years now, I've found the Avolio team to be a friendly and professional resource for all my needs: from grooming to feeding to my little Zack's equipment. Kindness, helpfulness, and respect for animals are hallmarks of this shop, making everyone who works there truly special.

I've been using the shop and grooming salon for my Cocker Spaniel for several years and have been very pleased with the professionalism and kindness. Rosa treats my Edy very well, and he comes into the shop very calmly (something I've never experienced elsewhere before).

We sincerely thank you for your review and for sharing your positive experience. We're delighted to hear that our service met your expectations. Customer satisfaction is our greatest reward and a motivation to improve every day. We hope to welcome you back soon. Thank you for your trust.

Best regards
Avolio Pet Shop and the staff
Kindness, friendliness, honesty...a wide selection at competitive prices! My Luna and I are very satisfied!
Friendly and helpful and my poodles are happy when I leave them there. I consider them the best, especially Rosa, the owner, and for me the best.

Bringing Lady to them was a wonderful discovery. ❤️🐾 From the first moment, you can feel the love, patience, and kindness they put into their work. They don't just do grooming: they take care of our four-legged friends with truly special attention.

Lady came out beautiful, smelling good, and above all happy... so much so, it seems, that she's fallen in love with them! 🥹💕 Every time she sees them, she's so happy, and that, to me, is worth more than a thousand words.

When we leave our furry friends in someone's care, we want to feel at ease and know they're being treated with the same love we would ourselves. And with them, this feeling is guaranteed.

Thank you so much for your professionalism, kindness, and above all for all the love you give our little ones. Lady has already chosen you... and so have we! ❤️🐶✨

I've been frequenting this shop for some time and have been truly impressed by the kindness and helpfulness of the staff. They've always been able to patiently advise me on the best product for my poodle, demonstrating a true passion for their work. I also go there for grooming and have always been very satisfied. The day before my appointment, I receive a reminder via WhatsApp, which is very convenient.
What can I say? Exceptional!
Very well-stocked shop with efficient and friendly staff. Nala gets her baths only from them.
Excellent, very well stocked, very kind, I'm very happy with them
Since we got Audrey, our dog, we've turned exclusively to them for purchases and grooming. They're competent and helpful professionals.
I'm taking my Pyrenean Shepherd, Simba, for a bath. They're good, gentle, and know how to treat our four-legged friends. I trust them exclusively for Simba's grooming. Highly recommended!

Well stocked.
Friendly and helpful staff.
Education, competence, kindness and many good products..... What more could you want 😍 …

Be careful if you buy dry cat food, especially if you order it directly at home. I bought a 10 kg pack for a fortune, and once I opened it, I discovered that my cat wouldn't eat it. They didn't even bother to consider exchanging it for another food, something other sellers do. I wasted 30 euros.

I've been a customer for several years. The staff are very helpful and knowledgeable. I've also been using their grooming service for my Cocker Spaniel for over a year now, as, like other dogs of this breed, his coat is difficult to manage. Unfortunately, I'd just had a terrible experience with incompetent people, so I asked Rosa for advice and entrusted myself to them. I'm very happy with the service; first and foremost, they have a love and passion for animals, as well as specific expertise in grooming. Now my Cocker Spaniel is beautifully groomed, and he's at peace. And most importantly, he's treated as if he were their own dog; his calmness is noticeable even when I go to pick him up. Rosa and Emanuele have a great love for animals and do their work with great passion and expertise. Definitely recommended!!! A special thank you also from my pet Coco.
Roberta
Thank you

This morning I took my pitt-like dog to get his nails trimmed. My dog ​​won't let ANYONE touch him, much less let me muzzle him. Dozens of vets and groomers have refused to trim his nails because he wasn't muzzled and would have bitten him. No sedation was given, and his nails ended up crooked, forcing the dog to limp. This morning we went to this place with a terrible fear, both for the groomers who might have been bitten and for my dog, who is scared and wary. I followed the whole thing on the camera set up specifically to show the owners what's going on inside. ABSOLUTE MASTERY, AN EXCEPTIONAL FEELING WITH THE DOG, two sensational guys who knew how to handle the situation with a rare level of professionalism. My dog ​​even asked for cuddles after having his nails trimmed. I recommend these groomers because they are passionate about their profession and truly love animals. I'll be back soon. THANK YOU GUYS
